reuse.why: The link handler reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and the shared linkBankSyncAccount; the download side follows the tree's per-provider function pattern rather than any shared helper (none exists).

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token lookup, post, error throw, response mapping), adding one more copy of that block.

placement.why: Handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, server path in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, exactly where the other providers live.

scope.why: Mostly focused, but the DbAccount account_sync_source union is widened with four unrelated providers instead of just adding fintegra or reusing AccountSyncSource.

maintainability.why: Consistent with how every other provider is wired, so easy to own, though it grows the copied download functions and the assert call is left unformatted.
